column1: # macOS defaults, tracked as data so both the apply script and the sync
# script (bin/sync-macos-defaults.sh) share a single source of truth.
# Edit this file to change the DECLARED (desired) state, then run
# `chezmoi apply` to push it to the system.
# Run `bin/sync-macos-defaults.sh` to pull the CURRENT system state back
# into this file (e.g. after changing something via System Settings), so
# the drift shows up as a normal git diff you can review, commit (accept)
